bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for water treatment plants in the city of Hastings.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. HASTINGS; WATER TREATMENT PLANTS.

$16,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Hastings to predesign, design, construct, and equip three water treatment plants and associated water mains to remove per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from city wells.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $16,600,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of Hastings to predesign, design, construct, and equip three water treatment plants and associated water mains to remove per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) from city wells.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
